{
  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_000_cost_logmeanexp",
  "intuition": "Apply a log-mean-exp aggregation to smooth pairwise losses, enhancing gradient signals on harder pairs while retaining pairwise logsigmoid structure.",
  "pseudocode": "for each pair: loss_i = -logsigmoid(clamp(alpha * scale * (lpw_i - lpl_i) - 0.1 * (cost_b_i - cost_a_i), -20, 20))\naggregated_loss = log(mean(exp(loss_i)))",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_margin",
    "signal_family": "cost_gap",
    "link_family": "logsigmoid",
    "agg_family": "logmeanexp",
    "constraint_family": "clamp_stabilized"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "logsigmoid",
    "clamp",
    "exp",
    "log",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "cost_a",
      "cost_b"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss_per_pair = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        weighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight\n        max_loss = ops.max(weighted_loss)\n        stabilized = weighted_loss - max_loss\n        logmeanexp = max_loss + ops.log(ops.mean(ops.exp(stabilized)))\n        return logmeanexp\n    else:\n        max_loss = ops.max(loss_per_pair)\n        stabilized = loss_per_pair - max_loss\n        logmeanexp = max_loss + ops.log(ops.mean(ops.exp(stabilized)))\n        return logmeanexp\n"
}

{
  "name": "loss_advantage_gap_logsigmoid_weighted",
  "intuition": "Repaired to change the paradigm_family from 'pairwise_margin' to 'pairwise' by implementing a classic pairwise logistic loss based on advantage gap difference. Instead of margin-based relu penalization, uses logsigmoid to directly encourage positive advantage gap alignment, which fits the 'pairwise' paradigm. Also switched constraint_family from 'relu_margin_penalty' to none, and signal_family kept as 'advantage_gap' to satisfy required changes while maintaining reliance on advantage_gap as quality signal. This ensures smooth gradients and conforms to expected operator contract.",
  "pseudocode": "logits = advantage_gap; loss = -mean(weight * logsigmoid(logits))",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "logsigmoid",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },

  "implementation_hint": {

    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    loss_raw = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(adv_gap))\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss_raw, weight)\n    else:\n        loss_weighted = loss_raw\n    return loss_weighted.mean()",

{
  "name": "loss_pairwise_advantage_tanh_ranking",
  "intuition": "Shift from margin-based pairwise loss with log-sigmoid link to a ranking loss using a tanh transformation of the advantage gap, encouraging smooth ranking margins modulated by the advantage signal.",
  "pseudocode": "score_diff = tanh(beta * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l))\nloss_per_pair = relu(1 - score_diff * advantage_gap)\nweighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight\nfinal_loss = mean(weighted_loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "relu_margin"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "tanh",
    "relu",
    "mul",
    "sub",
    "add",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 1.0)))\n\n    score_diff = ops.tanh(beta * (lpw - lpl))\n    margin_term = ops.sub(1.0, ops.mul(score_diff, adv_gap))\n    loss_per_pair = ops.relu(margin_term)\n\n    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)\n    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)"
}

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    entropy_w = batch.get('entropy_w', 0.0)\n    entropy_l = batch.get('entropy_l', 0.0)\n    entropy_diff = ops.sub(entropy_w, entropy_l)\n    adv_diff = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    norm_entropy = ops.tanh(entropy_diff)\n    weighted_adv = ops.mul(adv_diff, norm_entropy)\n    x = ops.clamp(weighted_adv, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = ops.neg(ops.sigmoid(x))\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
